info.name: Currency Converter API
info.description: Requests for the local currency converter that uses the Frankfurter exchange-rate API.

exec: pm.test('Returns the requested currencies', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.from).to.eql('INR'); pm.expect(body.to).to.eql('USD'); });
pm.test('Includes a positive exchange rate and result', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.rate).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(body.result).to.be.above(0); });
